notes.text: Taylor Hall is out (upper body injury) and has missed the last 8 games. Nikolaj Ehlers has taken his spot beside Logan Stankoven and Jackson Blake. That line has had 83% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 66:02 together, up from 60% with Hall.
Jordan Staal is out 1-2 months (calf tear) and has missed the last 10 games. Mark Jankowski has taken his spot beside Jordan Martinook and Nikolaj Ehlers.

Alexander Nikishin is out (not injury related) and has missed the last 8 games. Juuso Välimäki has taken his spot beside Shayne Gostisbehere. That pair has had 77% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 69:28 together.
Logan Stankoven has started killing penalties: on the ice for 26% of the team’s shorthanded time in 16 games, up from 1% last season.

The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 10 games cover only 30% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the 6th-lowest in the league (a typical team: 43%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Daemon Hunt joined from MIN on Oct 25 and has played beside Jayden Struble.
Adam Edström has started killing penalties: on the ice for 32% of the team’s shorthanded time in 14 games, up from 1% with his old team last season.

stakes: The Hurricanes go in first in the NHL with 26 points, the Predators tied for fifth in the Central with 15 points.

NSH.head: The Predators face a real test
NSH.body: Even though Nashville has home-ice advantage, Carolina has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Predators can pull it off if they get good looks.

CAR.head: Advantage, the Hurricanes
CAR.body: Even though Nashville has home-ice advantage, Carolina has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Predators’ way back in is getting good looks.

story.head: The Hurricanes are rolling
paras: The Predators (5-4-5) beat Tampa Bay 5-4 in a shootout on Saturday. The Hurricanes have won four straight, the last a 7-0 rout of Winnipeg. Going in, the Canes are first in the NHL and the Predators sixth in the Central (tied for 19th in the NHL).

The Hurricanes take away shots from the point (lowest) and create more chances on the penalty kill than anyone (1st), but give up a lot of dangerous shots (32nd). Carolina has scored 3.94 goals a game, the third most in the league, and allowed 2.19, the second fewest. The Predators keep things calm after the whistle (3rd lowest), get pinned in their own end on long shifts (32nd) and ice the puck a lot (29th). The Hurricanes’ power play against the Predators’ penalty killers is strength against strength, and the Hurricanes are likely to get plenty of pucks to the net against the Predators.

Sebastian Aho (9 G / 12 A / 21 P in 16 GP) leads the Hurricanes in scoring and is tied for seventh in the NHL, with seven points in his last five games and six goals in six games against Nashville since 2023-24. Logan Stankoven (10 G / 5 A / 15 P in 16 GP) has a team-high ten goals, tied for sixth in the NHL. For the Predators, Filip Forsberg (5 G / 12 A / 17 P in 14 GP) leads the way in scoring, with nine points in his last five games. Steven Stamkos (8 G / 8 A / 16 P in 14 GP) has a team-high eight goals.
Pyotr Kochetkov (10-0-0 / .929 SV% in 10 GS) has been outstanding for Carolina and will likely start. Juuse Saros (3-3-4 / .902 SV% in 10 GS) is in line to start for Nashville.

At home, Andrew Brunette likes to send Höglander, Wood and Forsberg out against opponents’ third lines, so watch for them against Martinook, Jankowski and Jarvis. Elsewhere, the Hurricanes usually control more of the chances than the Predators do.

items.text: Pyotr Kochetkov has won all ten of his starts this season, already the longest winning run to open a season by any goalie in franchise history.
The Hurricanes have been without Taylor Hall, Jordan Staal and Alexander Nikishin for several games.
Mark Jankowski has seven goals on chances worth about 3.0 goals, well above what his finishing usually turns chances into. Runs like that tend to cool off.
Jackson Blake and Nikolaj Ehlers have a point in six straight games.
